name: rbj_Launch18A430

name: rbj_Fall18A660

name: rbj_Land18A9A0

name: rbj_Move189ED0

name: rbj_Spawn18A060
notes: kind range check 0..0x22 done as two signed compares by the original and one unsigned compare by modern cl (bounds-check idiom); push w = 1.0 and actor velocity w = 1.0 stored from a register loaded from .rdata by the original and as immediates by modern cl; two assert-style hangs (pool missing and component 0xD missing)

name: rbj_Spin18AD70

name: rbj_Drop18C540

name: rbj_Burst18CE50

name: rbj_Bob16C690

name: rbj_Fall16FCB0
